_about: What each real JEE Advanced inorganic question (2019-2025, data/jee_advanced, 75 questions) asks, labelled by hand on 2026-11-25 (yardstick only; nothing from it goes into generation). Kinds: A property of NAMED species (shape, hybridisation, magnetism, MO, isomer-free structure); B1 identify the product/outcome of a described reaction; B2 hidden product(s), then a property of them; C amounts/moles from a reaction; D metallurgy/extraction process; E qualitative analysis (tests, precipitates, group reagents); F descriptive facts/trends (oxoacids, reducing agents, periodic trends); G solid state; H isomerism/coordination structure counting; R choice of reagent or starting material. Data errors seen: 2025P2_Q14 duplicates 2025P1_Q14 with a different full-marks %; 2022P1_Q16/Q17 'full marks' are counts (762.64, 249.81), not %.
